a.xlink:title: Abstract base class for all undoable operations.
Command to add a mixer channel to TrackManager.
Command to add a MIDI note to a pattern (undoable)
Groups multiple commands into a single undoable transaction (v1.0)
Command to create a new lane (track) in the playlist.
Command to duplicate a clip at a new position.
Groups multiple commands into a single undoable transaction.
Command to move a clip to a new position (and optionally a new lane)
Command to move a MIDI note to a new position and/or pitch (undoable)
Command to remove a clip from the playlist.
Command to remove a MIDI note from a pattern (undoable)
Command to resize a MIDI note's duration (undoable)
Command to toggle a channel's mute state.
Command to change a channel's pan position.
Command to toggle a channel's solo state.
Command to change a channel's volume.
Command to trim a clip's start/end positions.
Command to update a MIDI note's expression (velocity/pan) in place (undoable)
